propensity.model: ridge logistic regression (experiments.realdata_run._logistic_fit, l2 = 1e-2, Newton), covariates standardized by the pooled moments (realdata.load_rhc), as Table S7

estimands.one_minus_ovl: 1 - overlapping coefficient of the 40-bin histograms of e-hat on [0, 1] in the two arms (Table S7's overlap)
estimands.plugin: 1 - (1/N) sum_i min{e_i / pi, (1 - e_i) / (1 - pi)}, pi = n / (n + m)

propensity.bootstrap: 2000 resamples, stratified by arm, model refitted, seed 20261122; 95% percentile interval and the 5% quantile (one-sided 95% lower limit)
propensity.crossfit: 5-fold, folds stratified by arm, numpy default_rng(20261122)
